pairs: And the Lord spoke to Moses,
so that they may take the first-fruits to me.
ab omni homine qui offeret ultroneus, accipietis eas.
You shall accept these from every man who offers of his own accord.
Hæc sunt autem quæ accipere debeatis:
Now these are the things that you must accept:
and the skins of rams, dyed red,
lapides onychinos, et gemmas ad ornandum ephod, ac rationale.
onyx stones and gems to adorn the ephod as well as the breastplate.
And they shall make a sanctuary for me,
and I will live in their midst.
juxta omnem similitudinem tabernaculi quod ostendam tibi,
According to exact likeness of the tabernacle, and all of the vessels for its rituals,
et omnium vasorum in cultum ejus.
that I will reveal to you,
Join together an ark of setim wood,
cujus longitudo habeat duos et semis cubitos:
whose length shall hold two and one half cubits;
likewise, one and one half cubits.
Et deaurabis eam auro mundissimo intus
And you shall overlay it with the finest gold,
you shall fashion a gold crown all around,
quos pones per quatuor arcæ angulos:
which you shall set into the four corners of the ark.
duo circuli sint in latere uno,
Let two rings be on one side
Facies quoque vectes de lignis setim,
you shall make bars of setim wood and cover them with gold.
Inducesque per circulos qui sunt in arcæ lateribus,
And you shall put them through the rings that are in the sides of the ark,
so that it may be carried on them.
These must always be in the rings,
neither shall they ever be drawn out of them.
Ponesque in arca testificationem quam dabo tibi.
And you shall place the testimony, which I will give to you, in the ark.
Facies et propitiatorium de auro mundissimo:
You shall also make a propitiatory of the finest gold.
duos cubitos et dimidium tenebit longitudo ejus,
Its length shall hold two and one half cubits,
and the width, one and one half cubits.
you shall make two Cherubim of formed gold,
on both sides of the oracle.
Cherub unus sit in latere uno,
Let one Cherub be on the one side,
and the other be on the other.
Utrumque latus propitiatorii tegant expandentes alas, et operientes oraculum,
And let them cover both sides of the propitiatory, spreading their wings and covering the oracle,
respiciantque se mutuo versis vultibus in propitiatorium quo operienda est arca,
and let them look out toward one another, their faces being turned toward the propitiatory, with which the ark is to be covered,
in qua pones testimonium quod dabo tibi.
in which you will place the testimony that I will give to you.
et loquar ad te supra propitiatorium,
I will warn you and speak to you,
above the propitiatory and from the middle of the two Cherubim,
which will be over the ark of the testimony,
cuncta quæ mandabo per te filiis Israël.
about everything that I will command of the sons of Israel through you.
Facies et mensam de lignis setim,
You shall also make a table of setim wood,
et in altitudine cubitum et semissem.
and one cubit and one half cubits in height.
And you shall overlay it with the purest gold.
faciesque illi labium aureum per circuitum,
And you shall make it with a gold lip all around,
et ipsi labio coronam interrasilem altam quatuor digitis:
and for the lip itself an engraved crown,
and above it another little gold crown.
Quatuor quoque circulos aureos præparabis, et pones eis in quatuor angulis ejusdem mensæ per singulos pedes.
Likewise, you shall prepare four gold rings and set them in the four corners of the same table, over each foot.
so that the bars may be put through them and the table may be carried.
Ipsos quoque vectes facies de lignis setim,
Likewise, the bars themselves you shall make of setim wood,
et circumdabis auro ad subvehendam mensam.
and surround them with gold, to lift up the table.
You shall also prepare small cups,
with which the libations shall be offered,
Et pones super mensam panes propositionis in conspectu meo semper.
And you shall place upon the table the bread of the presence, in my sight always.
Facies et candelabrum ductile de auro mundissimo,
You shall also make a lampstand, formed from the finest gold,
along with its stem and arms,
as well as the lilies proceeding from it.
Six branches shall go out from the sides:
and three out of the other.
Tres scyphi quasi in nucis modum per calamos singulos,
Three bowls, the size of nuts, shall be on each branch,
and a little sphere with it,
et tres similiter scyphi instar nucis in calamo altero,
And three similar bowls, in the likeness of nuts, shall be on the other branch,
and a little sphere with it, and a lily.
This shall be the form of the six branches,
which are to proceed from the stem.
in ipso autem candelabro erunt quatuor scyphi in nucis modum, sphærulæque per singulos, et lilia.
Then, in the lampstand itself, there shall be four bowls, the size of nuts, and each with little spheres and lilies.
Sphærulæ sub duobus calamis per tria loca,
Little spheres under two branches in three places,
qui simul sex fiunt procedentes de hastili uno.
which together make six, shall proceed from one of the stems.
Et sphærulæ igitur et calami ex ipso erunt,
Thus both the little spheres and the branches shall be made out of the same thing:
entirely formed from the purest gold.
You shall also make seven lamps,
and you shall place them upon the lampstand,
so that they may give light in every direction.
et ubi quæ emuncta sunt extinguantur,
and the place where the candles will be extinguished,
shall be made from the purest gold.
Omne pondus candelabri cum universis vasis suis habebit talentum auri purissimi.
The entire weight of the candlestick, with all its parts, shall hold one talent of the purest gold.
et fac secundum exemplar quod tibi in monte monstratum est.
and then make it according to the example that was shown to you on the mountain.”
